newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 24.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* Republican congressional leaders agreed on a $16-billion plan to provide healthcare for uninsured children.
* President Clinton personally requested a list of potential political contributors in an effort to try to raise $1 millin for the Democrats.
* Boeing gave in to European demands and won approval of its $14 billion merger with McDonnell Douglas.
* A coalition of 68 churches, synagogues and nonprofit groups is refusing to hire workfare recipients under a New York City's plan that requires people to work for their benefits.
* The Senate committee investigating campaign finance abuses rebuffed the Justice Department today and voted to grant immunity from prosecution to five potential witnesses.
* The British government announced it plans to for the first time impose tuition fees on all college students.
